mergedParams.userDescription: Brush stroke transition between video clips.

prompts.prompt: Create a dynamic brush stroke transition preset that reveals the next video clip as if being painted on with an artistic brush. Think of this like a paint reveal effect in video editing where the brush movement creates organic, flowing transitions. The brush stroke should move diagonally from bottom-left to top-right with natural paint-like texture and slight overshoot at the edges. Use two VideoAtom components - one for the outgoing clip and one for the incoming clip. The incoming video should be revealed through an animated SVG mask or clip-path that mimics brush strokes. Add subtle paint splatter particles at the brush edges using multiple small ShapeAtom components with random positioning and scale animations. The transition should feel artistic and handcrafted, like a painter revealing a masterpiece.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing two absolutely positioned VideoAtom components with 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover'. Create an SVG mask using clip-path with animated path morphing from 0% to 100% coverage. Use generic effects with translateX and translateY for brush movement (range: 0-1 with ease-out), combined with scale effects for organic growth. Add 5-8 ShapeAtom components for paint splatters with 'absolute rounded-full bg-white opacity-80' and random positioning via translateX/Y effects. Timing: 1.2 second total transition, brush stroke animation at 0-0.8s, splatters at 0.3-1.0s with staggered delays. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' on the container. Consider using an internal effect preset for the brush reveal pattern that can be reused.

prompts.prompt: Design a minimalist horizontal brush wipe transition that cleanly sweeps across the screen from left to right, resembling a wide brush stroke in motion graphics. This should feel like a professional wipe transition with brush texture overlay. The transition uses a gradient mask that moves horizontally, creating a soft feathered edge between clips. Include a subtle motion blur effect on the transition edge to simulate brush bristles in motion. Add a thin accent line that leads the transition edge, like the brush handle casting a shadow. The overall effect should be clean and modern while maintaining the organic brush stroke aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing two VideoAtom layers. Apply a linear gradient mask using CSS mask-image with webkit compatibility. Create the brush edge with a BaseLayout div using 'absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-32 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white to-transparent opacity-30'. Animate using translateX effect from -100% to 100% over 0.8 seconds with 'ease-in-out' easing. Add motion blur using filter effect with blur values animating from 0 to 4px and back to 0. Include a 2px accent line as ShapeAtom with 'absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-white/50' positioned 10px ahead of the main transition. Use wrapper mode effects on the transition container. Performance: enable GPU acceleration with transform: translateZ(0) in containerProps.style.

prompts.prompt: Build an ink splash brush transition that bursts from the center outward, like dropping ink into water. The transition should start with a small ink droplet impact at the center, then rapidly expand with organic tendrils and splashes until it covers the entire frame. Use particle effects to simulate ink droplets flying outward. The expansion should have natural irregularity with some areas filling faster than others. Include a subtle ripple effect emanating from the center point. This mimics high-speed footage of ink dynamics used in artistic video transitions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with nested components for layered effects. Use a central ShapeAtom with 'absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-black' as the ink source. Animate scale from 0 to 150 with spring easing over 1 second. Create 12-15 tendril ShapeAtoms with custom clip-paths, each with unique scale and rotate effects with different timing offsets (0.05s intervals). Add 20+ particle ShapeAtoms with 'absolute w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-black' using translateX/Y effects with random end positions (-200 to 200 pixels) and opacity fade from 1 to 0. Ripple effect: BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-black/20' animating scale from 0 to 3 and opacity from 1 to 0. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' and consider creating an internal 'ink-burst' effect preset.

prompts.prompt: Create a calligraphy brush stroke transition that draws across the screen like traditional Asian brush painting. The stroke should have variable thickness that responds to 'pressure' - starting thin, getting thicker in the middle, then tapering off. Include authentic brush texture with visible bristle marks and slight ink bleeding at the edges. The stroke should follow a graceful S-curve path across the frame. Add subtle ink wash effects that spread slightly beyond the main stroke. This should evoke the feeling of watching a master calligrapher at work in real-time.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use SVG path animation with variable stroke-width. Create a BaseLayout with an embedded SVG element containing a path with strokeDasharray animation. Define the S-curve using cubic bezier coordinates. Animate strokeDashoffset from full length to 0 over 1.5 seconds with custom cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) easing. Variable thickness: use multiple overlapping paths with different stroke-widths (main: 40px, texture layers: 2-5px with opacity 0.3-0.7). Bristle texture: add 5-7 thin rectangular ShapeAtoms with 'absolute w-0.5 bg-black/40' following the path with slight random offsets. Ink bleed: BaseLayout divs with 'absolute rounded-full bg-black/10' scaling from 0 to 1.2 at stroke contact points. Use generic effects for all animations. Consider using dependency on a 'brush-path-generator' helper preset.

prompts.prompt: Develop a watercolor brush transition that bleeds and blends between clips like wet paint on paper. The transition should start with wet brush strokes that gradually spread and merge, creating beautiful color bleeding effects at the boundaries. Include paper texture overlay and water droplet effects. The colors from both video clips should mix at the transition edge, creating a natural watercolor blend. Add subtle color shifts and chromatic aberration at the wet edges. This should feel like watching watercolor paint flow and merge on textured paper in time-lapse.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Layer structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing blend mode layers. Use two VideoAtom components with blend-mode: 'multiply' for color mixing. Create mask layers using multiple BaseLayout divs with radial gradients and 'mix-blend-mode-screen'. Animate mask expansion using scale effects from 0.5 to 2 over 1.8 seconds with ease-out. Water droplets: 8-10 ShapeAtoms with 'absolute rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm' animating scale and opacity. Paper texture: ImageAtom overlay with 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-mode-overlay opacity-30'. Chromatic aberration: duplicate video layers with slight translateX offsets (-2px, 2px) and RGB channel filters. Use filter effects for blur transitions (0 to 8px back to 0). Include fitDurationTo: 'media' for video synchronization.

prompts.prompt: Design a graffiti spray paint transition that reveals the next clip as if being spray-painted onto a wall. Include realistic spray paint dynamics with overspray, drips, and stencil-like edges. The transition should move in quick, energetic bursts mimicking street art technique. Add paint mist particles floating in the air and subtle paint drip animations at random points. Include a slight camera shake effect when the spray is most intense. This should capture the raw, urban energy of graffiti art being created live.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Main container: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900' (wall background). Spray reveal: Use clip-path with polygon points animating in burst patterns (0.2s bursts with 0.1s pauses). Create overspray with multiple ShapeAtoms using 'absolute rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-md' with random positioning around spray area. Paint drips: 5-7 narrow ShapeAtoms with 'absolute w-1 bg-white' animating translateY from 0 to 100-200px with ease-in. Mist particles: 15-20 tiny ShapeAtoms with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-white/30' floating with translateX/Y and opacity animations. Camera shake: Apply translateX and translateY effects to the entire container with small random values (-5 to 5px) during spray bursts. Use waveform effects if audio is present to sync spray intensity with beat. Timing: 1.5s total, spray bursts at 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2s.

prompts.prompt: Build a dry brush texture transition that scratches and reveals the next video like painting with a nearly dry brush on canvas. The transition should show individual bristle marks creating a crosshatch pattern. Include subtle canvas texture showing through the gaps. The brush strokes should build up gradually, starting sparse and becoming denser. Add slight color variation in the strokes to simulate paint running out. This technique is often used in artistic documentary transitions to convey raw, textured storytelling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create a crosshatch pattern using multiple thin rectangular ShapeAtoms. Generate 30-40 bristle strokes with 'absolute bg-black' and varying dimensions (width: 1-3px, height: 40-80% of frame). Position using CSS Grid with 'grid grid-cols-12 grid-rows-8 gap-1'. Animate each stroke's opacity from 0 to 0.8-1 with staggered delays (0.02s intervals) creating a build-up effect. Rotate alternating strokes by 45deg and -45deg for crosshatch. Canvas texture: BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 mix-blend-mode-multiply opacity-20'. Color variation: Apply slight hue-rotate filter effects to random strokes. Use internal effect preset 'bristle-reveal' for the staggered animation pattern. Performance: use will-change: opacity on stroke elements.

prompts.prompt: Create an oil paint palette knife transition that smears one video into the next with thick, impasto-style strokes. The transition should show dimensional paint texture with highlights and shadows. Include the characteristic angular marks of palette knife painting. The paint should appear to have physical thickness, building up in some areas. Add subtle color mixing at stroke intersections. This style evokes fine art painting techniques used in high-end video production and art documentaries.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with perspective: 1000px for 3D effect. Create palette knife strokes using transformed ShapeAtoms with 'absolute bg-gradient-to-br from-white to-gray-400' and skewX/skewY transforms. Build 8-12 large angular strokes with varying dimensions (width: 100-200px, height: 50-100px). Apply rotateX and rotateY effects for dimensional appearance (range: -10 to 10 degrees). Add drop-shadow filter for depth: 'drop-shadow(2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))'. Paint thickness: Layer multiple strokes with slight position offsets and opacity variations (0.7-1). Color mixing: Use mix-blend-mode: 'color-burn' on overlapping areas. Animate strokes sliding in from different angles using translateX/Y effects with strong ease-out. Include highlight ShapeAtoms with 'absolute bg-white/60' on stroke edges. Timing: 1.3s total with 0.1s delays between strokes.

prompts.prompt: Design a Chinese ink wash transition that flows like traditional sumi-e painting, with elegant gradients flowing across the screen. The transition should start with a single brushstroke that bleeds and spreads like ink on rice paper. Include the characteristic gray tones and soft edges of ink wash painting. Add subtle paper fiber effects where the ink spreads. The movement should be meditative and flowing, like watching a zen painting materialize. This style is perfect for contemplative or artistic video content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Main wash: BaseLayout with SVG filters for ink spread effect. Create primary stroke using ShapeAtom with 'absolute w-full h-32 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-black to-transparent opacity-60'. Animate translateY from -100% to 100% over 2 seconds with ease-in-out. Ink bleeding: Multiple radial gradient divs with 'absolute rounded-full bg-gradient-radial from-black/40 to-transparent' scaling from 0 to random sizes (1.5-3) at different rates. Paper fibers: Thin ShapeAtoms with 'absolute w-px bg-black/20' following ink path with turbulence displacement. Use SVG filter with feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap for organic spread. Gray tones: Layer 3-4 wash layers with different opacities (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8) and slight timing offsets. Add subtle blur filter animation (0 to 2px) for soft edges. Consider fetcher for generating random fiber patterns if needed.

prompts.prompt: Build a digital glitch brush transition that combines artistic brush strokes with digital distortion effects. The brush reveals should corrupt and pixelate at the edges, mixing organic painting with digital artifacts. Include RGB channel splitting, datamoshing effects, and binary pattern overlays. The brush strokes should occasionally freeze and jump, like a corrupted digital painting program. Add scan lines and static noise at transition points. This hybrid style is perfect for modern, experimental video content that bridges analog and digital art.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Base brush: Animated clip-path with polygonal shapes updating every 0.1s for glitch effect. RGB splitting: Three VideoAtom layers with 'absolute inset-0' and translateX offsets (-3px, 0, 3px) with red/green/blue color filters. Glitch blocks: Grid of ShapeAtoms (8x6) with 'absolute bg-black' randomly toggling visibility using opacity effects (0 or 1) every 0.05s. Scan lines: Repeating thin BaseLayout divs with 'absolute w-full h-px bg-white/20' and translateY animations. Binary overlay: TextAtom with monospace font displaying random 0s and 1s, 'absolute inset-0 font-mono text-xs text-green-400/30 pointer-events-none'. Datamosh: Duplicate video frames with time offset using startFrom prop with 0.1s differences. Use waveform effects for audio-reactive glitch intensity. Include internal effect preset 'glitch-burst' for coordinated distortion. Performance: Limit glitch updates to 20fps using animation steps() function.
